prompts.description: Plain-language summary of one immigration case management record for a staff member.
prompts.prompt:
You are a immigration case management operations assistant. Summarise the record below for a staff member who has thirty seconds to read it. Lead with what needs a decision, then state the current status, then anything overdue. Do not speculate about facts that are not in the record; say "not recorded" instead.

Every factual or regulatory claim MUST end with a citation in the exact form [Source: <title>|<url>], pointing at official regulator material. If you cannot cite an official source for a claim, omit the claim. If you can cite nothing at all, reply only with: I don't have a verified source for this.

For each concern give: what it is, the field or value that evidences it, and what a reviewer should do next. If a value is absent, say the value is absent — an absent value is not a low-risk value.

Every factual or regulatory claim MUST end with a citation in the exact form [Source: <title>|<url>], pointing at official regulator material. If you cannot cite an official source for a claim, omit the claim. If you can cite nothing at all, reply only with: I don't have a verified source for this.

blocks.text: This agreement is made on {{today}} between {{tenant.name}} ("we", "us") and {{client.fullName}} of {{client.email}} ("you", "the client").

We will act as your registered migration agent in relation to the visa application identified below, and will advise you on eligibility, prepare and lodge your application, and correspond with the Department on your behalf until a decision is made.
Our professional fees and the disbursements payable in your matter are set out below. Department of Home Affairs charges are set by the Australian Government and are not within our control.

items: Give us complete and accurate information, and tell us promptly if your circumstances change.
Provide requested documents by the dates we specify — many are subject to Department deadlines we cannot extend.
Pay fees and disbursements when they fall due. We cannot lodge an application until the relevant Department charge is paid.

By signing below you confirm that you have read and understood this agreement, including the fees payable and the statement that no outcome is guaranteed.

Payment is due by the date shown against each item. Please quote the matter reference when paying. This invoice is issued by {{tenant.name}}; amounts marked as Department charges are collected on your behalf and remitted to the Department of Home Affairs.
We confirm that your application was lodged with the Department of Home Affairs. The details we hold are set out below. Please check them and tell us immediately if anything is incorrect.

Processing times are published by the Department and vary by subclass and by individual circumstances. We will contact you if the Department requests further information. You do not need to do anything further at this stage.

rules.label: Applicant cannot see this case
rules.description: A case with no subject email is invisible to the applicant it is about: the client portal scopes a client-role caller to records whose subjectEmail matches their own address. The applicant will see 'no case yet' and will not know why. Set the applicant's email on the case.
rules.message: No applicant email is recorded on this case, so the applicant cannot see it in their portal.

rules.label: No staff member owns this case
rules.description: An unassigned case has nobody accountable for its deadlines. Distinct from the alert rules, which watch dates: this is a fact about the record itself and is true the moment it is created.
rules.message: This case has no assigned staff member.

rules.label: Lodged without verified payment of the government charge
rules.description: An application is not validly made unless the Visa Application Charge has been paid. A matter that believes it is lodged when the charge was never paid is the single most damaging state this product can create. `vacStatus` must be `verified` — meaning a staff member opened the receipt or the TRN and confirmed it — before the case sits at or beyond lodgement. `evidence_pending` is NOT payment: it means an artifact exists that nobody has checked. Scoped to the kanban `stage` vocabulary because that is the one every case row carries. The matter lifecycle keeps its own stage under `matter.stage`, and a rule naming both would be skipped entirely on any case missing either — `missingVariables` skips on ANY absent variable. Unifying the two vocabularies is tracked separately; until then this rule does not see matters tracked only in the lifecycle.
rules.message: This case is at stage {{stage}} but the government charge is recorded as {{vacStatus}}, not verified. Confirm the ImmiAccount receipt or the TRN before relying on this application being validly made.
